designs.title: Pisa
designs.why: Instantly readable from across the shop: a stamp plus the Leaning Tower, with a clean one-ink line drawing that holds up when cropped close (arcades, belfry, the diamond inlays at the base). The '3.97°' denomination is a smart in-joke, since it reads as both the price on the stamp and the tower's lean, and gives the tee something to talk about at $50. It works on both white and black tees. Holding it back from a strong seller: the inside of the frame is mostly empty white, with big dead areas either side of a fairly narrow tower. The wavy perforated edge and the plain brick ground make it feel like a souvenir-shop item rather than a premium one.
designs.fix: Add a one-ink circular postmark cancellation (wavy lines and 'PISA · ITALIA') that overlaps the upper-right corner of the frame and partly crosses the tower. It fills the empty space, makes it obviously a used, collectible stamp and lifts it from souvenir to premium.
